description: Holds Mexican peso and Brazilian real futures, whose prices carry a large interest-rate differential, only while the 50-day average is above the 200-day average, so the carry is earned in calm markets and the crash risk is cut in a sell-off (after Burnside, Eichenbaum & Rebelo 2011). Falsified if the trend filter does not cut the carry crash drawdowns. Backtested on FinzData currency futures: front-month contract rolled on the FinzData roll calendar as an excess-return index, so the interest-rate differential (carry) is in the return; costs as stated, re-run free on full history.
title: High-yield currency carry with a trend filter · Mexican peso and Brazilian real futures 50/200
